Infrastructure: revenue £468m (-3%), operating profit £18.3m (-1%), margin 3.9%; FY2026 margin expected at top of 3.75%–4.25% range, revenue towards c£1bn (unchanged guidance) (source: same).

Group FY2026 outlook: full-year performance expected in line with current expectations; no explicit restatement of numeric guidance from 12 Feb or 16 Apr trading updates in this document (source: same).

FY2025/HY2025 restatement: Property Services fully integrated into Construction from 1 Jan 2026; segment tables for HY2025 and FY2025 restated accordingly (source: same).
